narration.text: You are looking at Casa Brück on Piața Unirii, designed by László Székely around 1910. Notice the curving lines and plant ornaments: Secession architects used them to give Timișoara's new buildings a bold, modern personality.
narration.history: In the early 1900s Timișoara expanded quickly, and Secession buildings like this one transformed the squares of the old Cetate district.
narration.why_it_matters: Casa Brück is one of the best-known Secession facades in Timișoara's historic centre.
